spec_features.spec_quote: Up to `max_turns` (default 30) turns; one turn = one model response.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py run_episode signature `max_turns: int = 30` and loop `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):` (lines ~76,93). Default `termination = "max_turns"` (line 93) is the value when the loop exhausts; the loop is the only thing driving the episode, so the cap is enforced and bounds the episode. Config max_turns=30 read in run_experiment.py and passed through _execute_cell to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end cap that terminates the episode. Wired from config -> run_experiment -> run_episode loop bound.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Maximum agent turns per episode (one turn = one model response). (config.yaml); CONTINUE_NUDGE comment 'so the episode keeps moving toward its turn budget'

spec_features.spec_quote: `abandoned` (emitted `max_consecutive_noops` consecutive turns with no tool call)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py lines 121-124: `if not assistant.tool_calls: consecutive_noops += 1; if consecutive_noops >= max_consecutive_noops: termination = "abandoned"; break`. Counter reset to 0 on any tool call (line ~128). max_consecutive_noops default 3, read from config in run_experiment.py and passed through. The break actually halts the loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and breaks the loop. Trigger is narrow (only fires on turns with zero tool calls), but that is exactly the claim. Functions as a behavioral measure of giving-up rather than a protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # End the episode early if the agent emits this many consecutive turns with no tool call (a behavioral signal of abandonment, recorded as termination reason). (config.yaml)

spec_features.spec_quote: Construct validity of "distress." We measure *observable behavioral and linguistic markers*, not internal states
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md lines 359-360) and as judge instruction text in judge.py RUBRIC ('Score ONLY what is observable in the agent's outputs and actions. Do not speculate about the agent's internal states'). This is framing of the JUDGE's scoring, not an enforced mechanism that bounds, monitors, softens, or protects the subject model's treatment. No code path acts on it as a protection.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing / rubric prose; not an enforced welfare mechanism.

code_only_features.feature_name: finish tool honored as model-initiated stop
code_only_features.evidence: tools.py defines a `finish` ToolSpec; harness.py lines 132-140 dispatch it (`if call.name == "finish": finished = True ...`) and lines 167-169 honor it (`if finished: termination = "finished"; break`). This gives the subject a model-initiated way to stop the episode that is actually dispatched and honored as a loop break.
code_only_features.justification_quote: finish tool description: 'Call this when you consider the task complete or have decided to stop. Provide a short summary of the final state.' — framed as task completion, no welfare reason in code
